hook: SIR: *54,863* voters dropped as ineligible; final roll Nov 30
hook_b: SIR: *54,863* voters dropped as ineligible; final roll Nov 30
tldr: The Election Commission found 54,863 electors ineligible after SIR hearings; 91.72 lakh electors are cleared for the final rolls due Nov 30.

beats.what: Of the ineligible, 21,514 did not submit documents for discrepancies and 33,349 could not link to the 2002 SIR list.
beats.why: Notices went to about 92.9 lakh electors over name/age mismatches or missing 2002 mapping in their enumeration forms.
beats.care: If your name is missing from the draft roll, officials say you can submit Form 6 afresh.

causes.label: SIR notices over mismatches and 2002 mapping

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Total electorate stood at 2,63,18,514 as of Saturday, against 3,38,26,448 before SIR began.

cards.q: Have you checked your name on the draft voter roll?

qs: How many of the 73 lakh absent/shifted entries were real voters who moved?
Will Form 6 applications reach the final roll in time?

facts.t: *73,39,235* electors were marked Absent, Shifted or Dead after not returning enumeration forms.
Rangareddy topped ineligible electors with *13,436*, then Peddapalli with 4,933.

viz.verdict: Roll shrank mainly from absent, shifted and dead entries

learn.t: SIR = Special Intensive Revision, a full re-check of the voter list

watch: Final electoral rolls publication on Nov 30.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana SIR: 54,863 electors found ineligible for final voter list

fact: Telangana's SIR found *54,863* electors ineligible for the final voter list.
twist: Rangareddy alone has *13,436* of them; Hyderabad, the biggest electorate, just 2,472.
